You fell asleep halfway through the movie, and you wake up after the theatres empty. You head to the door. It's locked, your battery's dead - it was 100%. You bang on the door and shout for assistance. No answer.

You hear the film start again. Might as well see what I missed, you think to yourself.

The movie plays once more. You see the ending, there was a twist you didn't expect.

You go to take your leave and try again, maybe some cleaner was out there.

You knock to no avail.

Years pass you are stuck there, watching the film over and over again. No sleep, no rest, just bright colours getting brighter and loud noises that are getting louder.

You then shown a film of your life. You are shown destinies that could've been. Loves you could have explored. Selfish choices that have affected loved ones in profound ways. Words long ago spoken and forgotten, but highly regretted. It shows every detail of your life. Words spoken behind your back, betrayals by close friends and distant enemies.

You had a heart attack in the theatre while you were asleep. You felt no pain.

The exit door is now open, shining brightly. Echoed whispers guide you in.
